tools.name: get_catalogue
tools.description: Get the 5Mins.ai content catalogue PDF for a specific topic area. Use this when a user wants to see what training content is available in a particular subject.

topic.description: Topic area for the catalogue. Options: compliance (full compliance training catalogue), financial-services (FS-specific compliance), hospitality (hospitality training platform), bite-sized (bite-sized content library), ai (AI training catalogue), leadership (leadership micro-lessons).
